description: Labels that say WHAT KIND of thing a bot pull request is bumping, so the review queue can be
sorted by the kind of check the reviewer has to do -- a CRD copy, a container image and a Helm
chart fail in different ways and are read differently.
Triage facets only: nothing in this repository's workflows, and no required check, keys off
a 'dependency-type:' label. Do not turn one into a gate without saying so here.

packageRules.description: CRD copies -- reviewed against the module that normally installs the same CRDs, not on their own
container images -- every docker dep here is digest-pinned, so these arrive as both version bumps and digest refreshes
Helm charts -- the bump can move values schema and rendered resources at once, so review is chart release notes rather than an image diff
